value.title: Ordinary vector rendering reads SQLite tiles without a global GeoJSON snapshot
value.statement: Supported Simple and Field Rule renderers of all six geometry kinds use complete SQLite originals through the RTree, full MVT8192 and stock CustomVectorSource13.7.1 without HTTP. Persisted mobile_render_mode/local_vector_tiles metadata is inert: it neither selects rendering nor permits hidden-layer identification. The old loopback server/encoder/routing are removed. Unknown custom renderer extensions retain only the explicit classic converter; they never restart an HTTP server. Cold/hot/lite/style/data load must not materialize the complete Java/GeoJSON layer. Preserve every eligible identity, rule/layout/paint/scale/label and original DB coordinate. Polygon Fill/Line exclude inline Point label roles; Symbol uses anchors. Selection/edit reads one unquantized DB original and only transient overlays remain GeoJSON. Cancel/save/hide/undo/ remap restore native background without a global list. Cancel source work before native detach/style/project/view replacement; canonical model, owner, source, content and style generations reject late delivery. Project retirement is immediate and nonblocking even from workers. Stable SQLite layer paths and transient native source identities are separate: every source generation has a distinct renderer ID so SDK13.7.1 cannot keep the previous loader/tile pyramid across same-ID replacement. Factories, visible labels, lookup and removal use that actual ID; explicit classic binding first retires the streaming generation. Real Canvas hide invalidates the previous content generation; edit activation must rebind a current provider while keeping its owned original hidden. Actual finish restores that same model ID before capturing the replacement. Duplicate/invalid hide and no-op show never invalidate a current provider, including while another object is hidden for Undo. Query and full clipping share the classic128/512 tile buffer (2048 of8192 extent), so switching storage paths cannot lose the previous margin before style translations. This parity floor does not promise arbitrary out-of-buffer translation visibility. No simplification, thinning, hidden layer fallback or partial successful PBF is allowed. Resource admission uses only measured free remainder. JNI/PBF decode is not zero-copy, a bounded cache does not cap every native allocation, and native contents/performance/2GiB acceptance must be recorded independently of compilation and JVM results. TrackLayer is outside VectorLayer admission: saved/active tracks retain preexisting complete GeoJSON snapshots and point arrays. This contract does not certify track residency/long-session RAM or remove all GeoJSON from the application.
